method: Three identical complete requests per case in listed order; one interpreter, geometry/table caches persist between cases. Interpreter loading and DOM rendering excluded. No original-binary timing is claimed.

request.technology:
; Sample BiCMOS Model

<chip>

	chipx = 128	; dimensions of the chip in x direction
	chipy = 128	; dimensions of the chip in y direction
	fftx = 64	; x-fft size (must be a power of 2)
	ffty = 64   	; y-fft size
	TechFile = BiCMOS.tek
	TechPath = .
	freq = .1
	eddy = 0
	eddy = 1

<layer> 0 			; p(-) Layer
	rho = 10		; ohm-cm
	t   = 800		; microns
        eps = 11.9

<layer>	1	   		; p(+) layer
	rho =  .1
	t = 2
	eps = 11.9

<layer>	2   			; Oxide Layer
	rho = 1e10
	t = 50
	eps = 4

<metal>  0
	layer = 1		; in p(+) layer
	rsh = 35		; sheet resistance (milli-ohm/sq)
	t = 0.4			; thickness in microns
	d =  2			; dist from bottom of layer (at surface)
	name = msub
	color = blue

<metal> 1 
	layer = 2
	rsh = 50
	t = .8
	d =  3
	name = m2
	color = green

<metal> 2 
	layer = 2
	rsh = 20
	t = 2
	d =  5
	name = m3
	color = red
<via> 0			; metal 3 to metal 2
	top = 2		; top metal layer
	bottom = 1	; bottom metal layer
	r = 2		; resistance per via
	width = .75	; width of via
	space = 1.5	; spacing btwn vias
	overplot1 = .5	; min spacing to metal layers
	overplot2 = .5
	name = via3
	color = white
<via> 1			; metal 3 to metal 2
	top = 1
	bottom = 0
	r = 3
	width = .5
	space = 1.3
	overplot1 = .35
	overplot2 = .35
	name = via2
	color = greenish
